newsitem.title: USA: USAir workers lose CWA representation bid.
newsitem.headline: USAir workers lose CWA representation bid.

text.p: USAir Group Inc's passenger service workers did not receive the majority vote required for Communications Workers of America (CWA) union representation after votes were counted Thursday by the National Mediation Board, according to a statement from the CWA.
A USAir spokesman said that preliminary figures show that of the 9272 USAir employees eligible to vote in the election, 3973 cast ballots in favor of CWA representation.
National Mediation Board rules require that the CWA receive a majority of the vote in order to win union representation at USAir.

The CWA said it will file objections to actions by USAir management against the organizing efforts of its passenger service employees, citing USAir's alleged use of employer-dominated employee organizations, a tactic that the CWA claims is in violation of labor laws that cover most workers.
